name: Hydra label transition
description: Move an issue from one pipeline state to the next: remove the label it is leaving, add the one it is entering, and read the result back. This is hydra's state machine as a flow — see openspec/changes/hydra-flows-first-port task 2.3. Both writes are brokered: the credential never reaches this app.

$bindings.remove.source: The uuid of the Source seeded from flows/hydra-forge.source.json on the target instance. Instance-specific; an importer resolves it by name.

config.$why: 404 is accepted: the issue may already have left that state, and a transition that is already half-applied must be idempotent rather than fatal. Every other status still fails the step.

The read-back is not decoration. A label write that 200s and a label that is actually set are different claims, and the supervisor's whole state machine is driven off the second one. Reading it back is how a caller can assert on the state rather than on the response.
